g1.label: Hello… I'm calling ___ the heating.
g1.why: Use calling about + topic to say why you are phoning.

g2.label: Could you possibly ___ someone round today?
g2.why: After could you (possibly), use the base form of the verb.

g3.label: I'm afraid that ___ be possible this week.
g3.why: Won't + be is the future; doesn't and isn't cannot go before be.

g4.label: I understand that, ___ the flat is really cold…
g4.why: But adds your counter-argument after you show you understand.

g5.label: What ___ I bring you an electric heater…?
g5.why: What if + clause makes a suggestion; what about needs a noun or -ing.

g6.label: 6. Sorry, I didn't quite ___ that.
g6.why: Catch means hear or understand, a fixed phrase on the phone.

g7.label: 7. So, ___ I understand you correctly, …
g7.why: If I understand you correctly checks that you heard the details right.

g8.label: 8. I completely ___ why you are upset.
g8.why: Understand why shows empathy; accept and allow do not fit here.

g9.label: 9. I'd really ___ it if you could call me back today.
g9.why: The fixed phrase is I'd appreciate it if you could…

g10.label: 10. I'll send you a short email to ___ what we agreed.
g10.why: To confirm means to make an agreement clear and sure in writing.
